name: Online Date Door
steps: Drag the key to the lock.
Pour the oil from the bucket onto the gears.
Use the knife on the watermelon.
Place the half watermelon on the door.
Give the poster to the man.
Guide the man to the door.
Use the paint on the man in white to erase him.
Place the missing piece on him.
Use the notebook on the table to unlock the password door.
Take the man hiding underneath and guide him to the door to complete the level.
